plainLanguage: Sugar Land has zoning; most new homes sit in R-1 single-family or Planned Development districts, but our dataset does not yet have the setbacks or lot limits, so you'll be asked to enter them from the zoning map or your plat. Sugar Land historically required brick or stone on homes; a 2019 state law limits cities from requiring specific materials, but HOA rules in neighborhoods like First Colony or Telfair often still do. We assume the 2021 residential code and climate zone 2A until verified. Sugar Land is not in the coastal windstorm area. Plan for an engineer-designed slab and check the floodplain map, as parts of the city lie near the Brazos River.
